# Diplomat Global Tech-Solutions — AI Guidelines
> Premium electronics e-commerce store in Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria. Sells monitors, cameras, computing gear, and printers with secure Paystack payment and nationwide delivery.

## About
Diplomat Global Tech-Solutions (BN 3049329) is a Nigerian electronics retailer based in Computer Village, Ikeja, Lagos. We sell new and certified pre-owned monitors, cameras, laptops, desktops, printers, and accessories. Orders are processed securely via Paystack and delivered nationwide.

## Key Facts
- Business name: Diplomat Global Tech-Solutions
- Business registration: BN 3049329
- Location: 14 Francis Oremeji Street, Distinct Plaza Suite 5, Opp. UBA PLC, Computer Village, Ikeja, Lagos
- Payment: Secure Paystack checkout (card, bank transfer, USSD)
- Delivery: Nationwide delivery across Nigeria
- Products: Electronics — monitors, cameras, computers, printers, accessories
- Currency: Nigerian Naira (₦)

## Crawl Policy
- Public product, blog, and informational pages are open for indexing
- Admin dashboard, API endpoints, checkout internals, and customer account pages are not for indexing
- See robots.txt for detailed access rules
